clock: Native first exported row = 0 s. Export has no packet counter, independent hardware event marker or per-packet receipt time.
donor: Within this split, use closest strictly earlier eligible original by native recording order within participant, hand, target and cutoff. Change only the accelerometer history. Use -1 if no earlier valid donor.
gallery: First usable development participant then earliest native recording, for each hand and target, allowing all future usable cutoffs in gallery. Require contiguous native time and finite display channels including a near-unit quaternion (norm within 0.001) for gallery only.
release: Numerical decoding train first. Validate source-bound authorization from the integration owner before each evaluation split. Copying opaque selected file bytes for a single archive decompression pass does not open numerical outcomes.
roster: Same 24 development participants; separately numbered native recording series per hand. Use both original modality flags. Never replace excluded trials. Fit/validation/test span zero-based assigned repetitions 2..5/6..7/8..9.
source_protocol_id: Ruhr cylinder inertial single-clock repetition forecast

window.outcome: axis-wise mean of next 10 consecutive samples including cutoff
window.sources: Native device XYZ calibrated acceleration with gravity, native gyro XYZ, both required finite for joint windows. Ignore other columns for eligibility. Keep zero. Retain complete rows without imputation. Record skipped/incomplete windows.
